billing.note: charged_credits is what the customer was billed for this run, from the ledger, capped at budget_credits. Report these numbers, not usage.*_usd.

pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

data.name: StonkFun
data.description: A Solana launchpad to launch coins paired with anything.

genuineSpikes: Large Raydium Burn & Earn harvest day paid to the operator wallet

methodology.Fees: Trading fees StonkFun collects, measured when it claims them: the 1% platform fee on its Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves (every platform config whose fees it claims), the creator fee on the Raydium CPMM pools those launches graduate into, and the quote side of fees harvested from the permanently locked liquidity behind pre-LaunchLab launches. Raydium's own fee shares are excluded. Each token is valued with Dune trade prices at the hour it was received, ignoring trades priced more than 10x away from that day's median.
methodology.Revenue: Fees less the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, as paid out on-chain. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded: they cannot fund a STONK buyback.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator and flywheel shares of fees, measured when they are paid out.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter, identified on-chain as swaps that returned STONK to the operator wallet, at the net amount each swap spent.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees StonkFun keeps after paying the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, minus the quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded. Buybacks spend income claimed on earlier days, so this is negative when a buyback is larger than the day's retained fees.

Fees.Launch Curve Platform Fee: 1% of every LaunchLab bonding curve trade, claimed from the platform fee vaults in each pool's quote token.
Fees.Graduated Pool Creator Fee: Creator fee on swaps in the CPMM pools graduated launches migrate into, claimed by StonkFun as pool creator; quote side only.
Fees.Locked LP Trading Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the permanently locked launch positions.

UserFees.Launch Curve Platform Fee: 1% of every LaunchLab bonding curve trade, claimed from the platform fee vaults in each pool's quote token.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Creator Fee: Creator fee on swaps in the CPMM pools graduated launches migrate into, claimed by StonkFun as pool creator; quote side only.
UserFees.Locked LP Trading Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the permanently locked launch positions.

Revenue.Graduated Pool Creator Fee: Creator fees claimed from graduated pools.
Revenue.Locked LP Trading Fees: Quote-token fees retained by the protocol.
Revenue.Creator Fee Share: Deducted: the creator share paid out to launch creators.
Revenue.Flywheel Share: Deducted: the flywheel share paid out to the flywheel wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fee Share: Creator share of standard-launch fees, paid to each launch's creator wallet.
SupplySideRevenue.Flywheel Share: Flywheel share of reward-launch fees, paid to the flywheel wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees to Protocol: Fees kept after creator and flywheel payouts, minus quote assets spent buying STONK. Negative when a buyback spends income claimed on earlier days.

HoldersRevenue.STONK Buyback And Burn: Revenue spent buying the platform token back and burning it.

data.description: Pons is a token launchpad for creating and trading fixed-supply tokens that progress toward liquidity graduation on Robinhood Chain

methodology.Volume: Volume of all swaps on Pons' launch curve, external uniswap v4 swaps are excluded
methodology.Fees: Includes launch fees, curve swap fees and swap fees post graduation (uniswap v4 : realised through fee swept events)
methodology.Revenue: Includes all the launch fees and part of swap fees
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Includes swap fees to creators, taxes (optional) to creators and buybacks (if enabled by creators) of meme tokens

Fees.Launch Fees: 0.0005 ETH charged for each token launched
Fees.Curve Swap Fees: Fees and taxes collected from curve swaps on Pons' launch curve
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Fees and taxes collected from uniswap v4 swaps on graduated pools (realised through fee swept events)

Revenue.Launch Fees to Protocol: All the launch fees (0.0005 ETH per token launched) collected goes to the protocol
Revenue.Curve Swap Fees to Protocol: Part of (30% for most pools) the curve swap fees collected goes to the protocol
Revenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: Part of (30% for most pools) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the protocol

SupplySideRevenue.Curve Swap Fees to Creators: Part of (70% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the curve swap fees collected goes to the creators
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Creators: Part of (70% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the creators
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax: Taxes collected from creators (if enabled) on curve swaps
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Meme Token Buybacks: Part of (0% when buyback is disabled, 35% when buyback is enabled) the uniswap v4 swap fees collected goes to the buyback and burning of meme tokens

data.name: Flap sh
data.description: Launch your crypto token with Flap.sh in one click, join the Meme Battle, and create your coin today on the ultimate trading platform.

methodology.Volume: Buy and sell volume on Flap bonding curves before tokens move to a DEX.
methodology.Fees: Protocol revenue (quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe, including wrapped-native transfers such as WBNB) plus token-tax amounts routed to marketing/vault recipients and token-holder dividends.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — all fees paid by traders and token-tax participants.
methodology.Revenue: All quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe, from any sender. Includes native SafeReceived and configured ERC20 quote transfers, plus wrapped-native (e.g. WBNB) transfers from TaxProcessor fee settlement.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue — all quote inflows to the Flap fee Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Token tax routed outside the protocol Safe: V1 TaxSplitter beneficiary payouts, plus V2/V3 TaxProcessor market and dividend buckets.

Fees.Treasury Received: Quote tokens transferred to the Flap fee Safe (native SafeReceived and ERC20 Transfer to the Safe), with no sender filter.
Fees.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 token tax paid to TaxSplitter beneficiary addresses (TaxSentToBeneficiary).
Fees.Token Tax to Market: V2/V3 token tax market/vault bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (marketAmount).
Fees.Token Tax to Dividends: V2/V3 token tax holder dividend bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (dividendAmount).

UserFees.Treasury Received: Quote tokens transferred to the Flap fee Safe (native SafeReceived and ERC20 Transfer to the Safe), with no sender filter.
UserFees.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 token tax paid to TaxSplitter beneficiary addresses (TaxSentToBeneficiary).
UserFees.Token Tax to Market: V2/V3 token tax market/vault bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (marketAmount).
UserFees.Token Tax to Dividends: V2/V3 token tax holder dividend bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (dividendAmount).

Revenue.Treasury Received: Quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Treasury Received: Quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 TaxSplitter payouts to configured beneficiary addresses.
